title: Workshop item
description: One workshop item (WS): a fix, a problem or a piece of recurring maintenance, back-at-base work that is not a mission. Filed by identifier, WS001.json.

kind.description: the words workshop-item, which is what chooses this schema

id.description: this item's identifier, WS and three digits in the order raised, the same identifier the file is named for

raised.description: the day it was raised, YYYY-MM-DD

source.description: where it came from: a seat and session, a review, or the commander

status.description: where the item stands: open, swept into a mission, fixed or dropped

recurring.description: true for maintenance that comes round again rather than a one-off fix

swept_into.description: the mission the item was swept into, M and three digits; absent otherwise

resolved.description: the date it was fixed or dropped and where, in one line; absent while it is open

notes.description: anything the one-line title cannot carry
